quick_ref.Theme: Unit 1: Identity & Environment — The Busy Classroom

methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: Plural Existence & Counting
content: Problem: Students know how to identify singular objects and state their existence ("There is a pen"), but they struggle with pluralizing nouns and agreeing the verb "to be" for multiple items.

Solution: Week 8 explicitly transitions students from "There is a..." to "There are..." with plural nouns (adding -s / -es). Anchored in the "Busy Classroom" theme, students physically count objects around them to solidify the concept of plurality.

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: Pull-out oral tasks (teacher does these with 1–2 students while class works):
S1 pull-out: Point to the desks. Ask: "How many desks are there?" Student: "There are 5 desks."
S2 pull-out: Show a box with markers. Ask: "What is in the box?" Student: "There are markers in the box."
S3 pull-out: Student reads S3 VC script aloud → teacher notes pronunciation errors (plural '-s' endings) → recasts.
Materials needed: Print 2 copies of Card A and 2 copies of Card B.
Give Card A to Student A, Card B to Student B.
Students do not show their cards. They ask each other the target question to fill in the missing information.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W8: desks, chairs, students, pencils, books
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (desks, chairs, students, pencils, books) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: "There are..." (Plural existence) + Plural nouns
instructions: Grammar focus this week: "There are..." (Plural existence) + Plural nouns.
Speed Read: Display sentence for 5 sec. Teams write C (correct) or E (error) on whiteboards simultaneously — no copying allowed.
Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.name: Story Race
games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Identity & Environment — The Busy Classroom"
instructions: Give each pair a story starter connected to this week's theme: "Identity & Environment — The Busy Classroom".
Pair A adds 2 sentences — must include at least 2 vocab words from this week.
Pass to Pair B: they MUST correct any grammar mistake from Pair A first, then add 2 more sentences using different vocab words.
Final round: Each pair presents their story ending aloud. Class votes on most creative + most accurate (desks, chairs, students, pencils, books usage). Teacher scores grammar precision.

listening_script.text: Welcome to the Hero Academy classroom! It is very busy! There are 20 desks. There are 20 chairs. There are many students. They are happy! There are books on the desks. There are pencils and pens. There are colorful markers. There are two boards on the wall. This classroom is ready for learning!
